title: What's New: Auto-Applying Templates in Integration with Dataverse (2024 release wave 2)

features.name: Auto-Apply Templates in Integration with Dataverse
features.description: Conditionally apply configuration templates to data synchronized between Dataverse and Business Central using rule-based filters and evaluation priorities without extending integration solutions.
caveats: Requires configuration in integration table mappings
Both table and integration table configuration templates are supported
Works bidirectionally between Business Central and Dataverse

features.name: Configuration Template Setup Pages
features.description: New pages accessible through drill-down from integration table mapping where users can set conditions via filters and define evaluation priorities for template application.
caveats: Accessible only through integration table mapping drill-down

features.name: Template Filter Conditions
features.description: Define filters that must be satisfied for a template to be applied, allowing rule-based selection of which templates apply during data synchronization based on record field values.

features.name: Template Evaluation Priority
features.description: Set the order in which different template filters are evaluated when a new record is created, allowing control over which template gets applied first.
caveats: Priority field shows the order of evaluation
